3. Support for extended conversations
Shizuku-Duplex implements a compaction mechanism, meaning the model can continue to have long conversations without degrading performance, or causing interruptions in dialogue. Conversations with Shizuku can go on for as long as you want. https://t.co/CV7Oq3qpMV

posts.text:
2. Asynchronous tool use

Shizuku-Duplex also supports delegation of tool-calling to a background model, meaning it can search for information to enrich your conversations, all while maintaining the conversation flow. Eliminating the dead gap between speaking and tool-call https://t.co/mw8us6eSFB

posts.text:
Shizuku-Duplex keeps Japanese voice interaction running while a background model searches the web.

Its 80 ms tick is not response latency. The company-created benchmark reports 79% multi-turn QA accuracy versus GPT-Live's 95%.
